name: Agrisilvicultural agroforestry (trees with crops)

soft_risks.risk: Trees compete with the crop for water, and FAO records SOC decreases under agroforestry in dry climates
soft_risks.mitigation: Use drought-tolerant species at wide spacing and stay below the optimal tree density threshold

soft_risks.risk: Crop yield falls in mature, highly dense plantations through competition for light, water and nutrients
soft_risks.mitigation: Prune to manage shade and keep density below the threshold where competition dominates

mechanism: Trees add deep roots and litterfall that build carbon, while the canopy moderates microclimate and provides habitat structure the cropped field lacks.

region_variants.note: Rainfed Ailanthus and aonla-based models are the region-matched systems documented for this zone.
